answer: To stop Sybil attacks, we implement Stake-Bonded TPM Attestation. First, every agent must link a unique hardware TPM chip to their digital identity. Second, the agent deposits a $10,000 bond into a cryptographic haven. Third, the network validates the hardware signature via decentralized nodes. Fourth, any detected fraud triggers immediate slashing of the bond. An attacker faces a $100,000 cost for ten identities and 48 hours of setup. This keeps the malicious horizon out of reach. It is like trying to mint a copper coin using a heavy, rusted press; the effort is too high.
